subject.title: PRs can appear green without the CI workflow ever running for the head SHA

question: Which durable CI safeguard should own the dropped head-SHA workflow case: a required CI check, an automated missing-run guard, or an initial documentation-only recovery improvement?
rationale: Each option changes maintainer operations and branch-protection behavior differently; the report supplies evidence for the incident but not a repository-approved choice among those operational contracts.

options.title: Require head-attached CI
options.body: Make the CI check required so a missing run appears as expected or waiting rather than allowing a deceptively green PR.

options.title: Add a missing-run guard
options.body: Have a bounded guard report or recover an absent head-SHA CI run after a delay, with careful duplicate-run handling.

options.title: Document recovery first
options.body: Improve AGENTS.md and the prepare-run diagnostic with the exact-SHA release-gate dispatch while a stronger gate is designed.

recommendation.title: Require head-attached CI
recommendation.body: Make the CI check required so a missing run appears as expected or waiting rather than allowing a deceptively green PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The incident report contains the most concrete current operational evidence and remediation options.
